h:
简单的文本到图像与高分辨率修复 ComfyUI 工作流程生成与我的模型展示图像相同的图像。

笔记。该工作流程使用 rg Three 的 ComfyUI 节点，必须使用管理器下载才能使用该工作流程。

下载展示图片（确保其为.PNG）并拖至 comfyui 或下载 json 文件并将其拖至 comfyui 中使用。

提示。您可以通过右键单击组节点并将组节点（高分辨率修复）设置为从不来跳过高分辨率修复

o.en:
simple text-to-image with high-res fix ComfyUI workflow to generate images identical to my showcase images for my models.

note. the workflow uses rgthree's ComfyUI Nodes it must be downloaded using the manager to use the workflow.

download the showcase image (make sure its .PNG) and drag to comfyui or download the json file and drag it in comfyui to use.

tip. you can skip high-res fix by right clicking the group node and setting group node (highres fix) to never
